newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: N.Korea can produce 100 Scud missiles yearly - Seoul.
newsitem.headline: N.Korea can produce 100 Scud missiles yearly - Seoul.

text.p: North Korea can produce around 100 Scud B and C missiles a year and has so far exported about 400 of them to the Middle East, the South Korean unification ministry said on Wednesday.

A ministry statement said North Korea has been exporting plants and machinery equipment for the production of the Scud missiles to Iran and Syria as well as technology for the development of the deadly weapons.

A unification ministry official said North Korea now exports about $500 million worth of Scud missiles a year. Its weaponry exports between 1980 and 1993 accounted for about 30 percent of its total exports amounting to $20.4 billion during the period.

"Since the collapse of the Soviet Union and the start of supplies of conventional Soviet-made weapons in the early 1990s, the North has focused its arms exports on strategic weapons including Scud missiles," the statement said.

South Korea's 655,000 armed forces, bolstered by about 37,000 U.S. troops, now confront the North's 1.1 million-strong army across the world's last-remaining Cold War border since the 1950-53 Korean War ended only with an armistice agreement.
